user_problem: Sources report values at different time grains, making joins or comparisons easy to misstate.
unique_output: An alignment plan stating source grains, permissible rollups, forbidden expansions, boundary conventions, and gaps.
required_input: Timestamp fields, time zones, calendar definitions, aggregation rules, and intended comparison grain.
critical_rule: Never expand coarse observations into finer periods unless an explicit allocation rule is supplied.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is weighted-rate-audit; this aligns temporal grains rather than checking weighted calculations.
acceptance_scenario: Input daily sales in UTC, monthly targets by calendar month UTC, desired monthly comparison, and sum rule for sales. Output permits daily-to-monthly summation, retains targets monthly, and states that monthly targets cannot support daily comparison.
